reviews.comment: You can tell that Dr. Johansen knows what she is talking about and is extremely educated. She's a bit of a tough grader but if you go to her office hours and ask for feedback, you'll be fine. Attendance is important to pass but not "mandatory."
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: It is possible to get by in this class without reading a whole lot, but it is also very lecture heavy. The lectures can be really long-winded, repetitive, and hard to understand sometimes, but topics do come up on the exams. The exams and weekly quizzes are open book/open note. It was confusing for me but i'm sure her teaching style works for some.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Ms. Johansen is awesome! Can't recommend her enough! I won't lie I barely did any of the readings, but I showed up to class and learned what I needed from class discussions. There is several quizzes, all are online, open book, no time limit. There are three exams, all online, no time limit, writing about passages. Without reading I got all A's.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Prof Johansen was great. She gave excellent lectures. There are 5 books to read in total, and as long as you go to class and take good lecture notes she gives you all the analysis you need to write the free response ?s on the exams. Only 3 exams, and 1 quiz a week w only 4 super simple questions over the book you read. Books also aren't that bad.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Johansen's lectures were so good-- it's clear she put a lot of time into book selection and had a really meaningful approach to the course. The contract grading system definitely helped much of the class make an A in the end. She was understanding and very generous w deadlines. Never wasted anyone's time. 10/10 prof I learned a bunch.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: You're going to have to purchase a few books and make sure you read them or you won't pass the quizzes each week. The tests are are all essays on the books you read too. I never went to class and managed an A, however, I made sure I read and I also like writing, so if you don't like essays, I wouldn't take the class. Lectures extremely confusing.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Johansen is passionate about English. Clear instructions. Always made herself available. Get ready to read every single night and participate in class every day. She stuck to the same structure of discussion/lecture almost every class. Her lectures might seem long at times, but will make you think about things in ways you never have before.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Participation matters, but you can have a few absences! We had lots of reading assignments, but only 2 papers and a project. You CAN make an A with minimal effort though. Profesor mostly lectures the whole class, but is very passionate.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Johansen is very passionate about what she teaches. You have to be an amazing writer to get an A..., but overall this class is a great one to take to get an English credit out of the way. She was great during office hours. Lots of books to read and discussions during every class.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: There are 7 novels for this class (each is around 300 pages). She speaks very fast, making it difficult to take notes, but she makes it obvious which terms will be included on exams. Her TA grades her tests and would often make mistakes, but she's very approachable after class and is willing to go over your exam if you disagree with your grade.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: This class is easier if you actually read the books, which I did. Some are not all that great, but it really isn't bad if you keep up with it. Tests are all written and based off books and vocab she gives you in class. I didn't pay attention in class, only wrote vocab down and main points, but for sure read the books to do well. Quizzes every week
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: She is a great person to carry a conversation and bounce around ideas with. Attendance was mandatory, but she lets you make up some absences with events, lectures, or plays you can attend. The only downside is that she told us halfway through the semester that she rarely gives A's because she has to be REALLY impressed with your work for that.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: She talks quickly, uses complicated language that nobody understands, and gives one quiz online every week. Her TA grades all the tests, which are short answer and essay tests, and he doesn't grade very accurately. Read 7 books in the semester, and they all run together at the end. I wouldn't take her again, but the books are interesting.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Be prepared to read 7 books that are about 300-500 pages each. There is a reading quiz almost every week over the book that the class is covering that week. The 3 exams make up 90% of the semester grade and are graded somewhat harshly but everything you'll need to do well is said in lecture. Dr. Johansen is a very caring, and overall decent prof.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Be prepared to read boring books that are at least 300 pages in a short span of time. There is a quiz every week over one of the books. The exams are solely based on her lectures, and are graded rather harshly. If you want an easy class, don't take this one.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: There were 7 books that were around 300-500 pages long. I didn't have time to keep up with the reading, and there was no opportunity to catch up. The exams are all essay, and they were graded harshly. Her grader also messed up several times. She has interesting lectures but she talks fast. You need to come to class every day and be ready to type.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: You have 7 books to read but her lectures give you exactly what you need for the exams which are all short answer, while the final has an essay as well. You only need to read for the weekly quizzes she gives. But her class is easy because she gives you exactly what to write on the exams in class. She talks really fast which is my only complaint
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I have never struggled so much in an English class. I also have never felt more unprepared for exams in my life. You have to read a lot and they aren't they best books but that not my problem its the fact that she doesn't help the students prepare for the test. Going into the Final half of my class has no idea how exactly to study for it.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: This course was a good choice to fill up one last English credit without wanting to die inside. The books for this class were all 21st Century, easy, and cheap to get. I did not enjoy the books very much, but I learned a lot in the class just by listening to her. Go to class - her lectures give you everything you need to do well on the exams.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Inspirational--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I took her 21st century lit class and her choices of books were all entertaining for the most part. I suggest studying in groups because people catch different things from her lectures and it's nice to get multiple opinions, especially if you miss class. Pretty much if you take or get decent notes and use detail in your short essays you're fine.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I had her for ENGL 206 and I really loved this class and this prof! She talks really fast so I suggest typing your notes, the lectures are really important. The class is reading intensive but the books are pretty interesting to read. I looked forward to going to class because the lectures were interesting and informative.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: If you do not go to class you will struggle. Her tests are based solely off of what she says about the novels in her lectures and she does not post the slides online. However, you want to write down most of what she actually says not just what is on the slides. You have to read multiple 400+ page novels which is time consuming but I enjoyed a few
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor Johansen's class is definitely a great choice! Get ready to read about six to  seven books. You will never be up to speed, unless you have all the time in the world! If you can take really good notes, you will do great in her tests. She is definitely knowledgeable in her subject! If you need to take a literature class, take this one!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Definitely a hard class, mostly because Professor Johansen knows so much about the material she teaches. You have to read the books, but the online reading quizzes are super easy after that. She likes to have what she says in class regurgitated back to her on the tests. If you go to class, take good notes, and study hard you can pull out an A.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: She gives you quizzes that are worth 1 pt. Tests are worth 20, it's passage identification and short answers until the final which is a whole essay and passage identification on all 7 novels. 3 tests and about 10 quizzes. THIS IS NOT AN EASY CLASS
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: She is one of my favorite professors I have taken so far and really wants you to do well in the class. She loves her job and you can tell by the way she teaches and interacts.
